description: On the market for the first time ever! This one owner, meticulously maintained 3-bedroom, 1.75-bath rambler sits in Lacey's sought-after Catherine Estates neighborhood. It offers 1,890 sq ft of easy single-level living, a brand-new roof, and true move-in ready condition. The open-concept floor plan keeps everyone connected. Gather around the cozy gas fireplace on cool Northwest evenings, and stay comfortable all summer with air conditioning. The kitchen has a walk-in pantry, under-cabinet lighting, and a stainless steel refrigerator, all open to the main living space. The oversized primary bedroom includes a large walk-in closet and an attached bathroom with an easy step-in shower. Two more generously sized bedrooms give you room for guests, hobbies, or a home office. Wide doorways that fit a wheelchair and just one step at the entry make getting around simple. Along with the new roof, you'll find double-pane vinyl windows, high-quality blinds, and upgraded LED lighting inside the home, in the garage, and outside.
